# Vendored wayland-protocols

`ext-data-control/ext-data-control-v1.xml` is copied verbatim from
[wayland-protocols](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wayland/wayland-protocols)
tag `1.45`, path `staging/ext-data-control/ext-data-control-v1.xml`.

It is used to generate client bindings for reading the primary selection on
Wayland. The protocol is MIT licensed; see `COPYING` in this directory.
